episodes.title: Épisode 1
episodes.summary: David, a high-ranking GIGN officer, is preparing to leave field operations. But a new recruit's graduation and a shocking attack threaten his plans.

episodes.title: Épisode 2
episodes.summary: Devastated by the previous night's events and under new scrutiny, the squad tracks down a suspect. On a mission, Max disobeys a direct order from David.

episodes.title: Épisode 3
episodes.summary: After the forest shootout, David pockets key evidence. Max continues to question his father's death, and a hospital visit takes an ominous turn.

episodes.title: Épisode 4
episodes.summary: Having linked the mastermind behind the attacks to an old operation, David goes on a rogue mission – but he's not the only one searching for answers.

episodes.title: Épisode 5
episodes.summary: David faces the consequences of his actions. Brought in for questioning, he tries to protect Max, and finally tells his godson the whole truth.

episodes.title: Épisode 6
episodes.summary: As news of a hostage situation reaches the squad, they race to launch a rescue mission and take down a skilled assassin who has nothing left to lose.
